content.overview: The remuneration of the auditor of a company shall be fixed in its general meeting or in such manner as the company in general meeting may determine. The Board may fix the remuneration of the first auditor appointed by the Board. The remuneration, in addition to the fee payable for an audit, includes any expenses incurred by the auditor in connection with the audit of the company and any facility extended to him but does not include any remuneration paid to him for any other service rendered to the company.
content.glance: Auditor remuneration is fixed by the members in general meeting (or as the meeting determines); Board may fix first auditor's remuneration.
content.study:
## Section 142 — Remuneration of auditors

**Members fix.** Remuneration of the auditor is fixed in general meeting, or in such manner as may be determined therein.

**First auditor.** The Board may fix the remuneration of the first auditor appointed by the Board.

**What is included.** Fee for the audit plus expenses incurred in connection with the audit and any facility extended. It does **not** include remuneration for any other service rendered at the request of the company (other services constrained by section 144).

This note is a focused study aid; the topic remains under source and current-law review.
